evidence: Real gate: tests/scoring.toml:1-3 has render=0.0 and constraints=0.0; test.sh and tools/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template, so a failed gate zeroes the reward before the scored suite. tests/gates/render/prompt.md:5 says 'A blank page, a generic error, an unavailable server, or a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails' and judge.toml:23 (cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing, binary, all_pass) needs load, a real typed word appearing in the editor, and reload. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 (cw_shared_saved_record) is the server-backing leg: Save succeeds, all browser storage for the origin is cleared, reload, exact title/filename/source re-read, second reload. That leg has a public basis in environment/instructions/behaviour.md:9 and integration.md:7; the custom-surface leg (judge.toml:23 of constraints) in ui.md:3 and policy.md:3. No auth leg is needed: app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in', matching instruction.md:5. In-dimension gate is restated at line 5 of each scored prompt (functional, polish, visual): 'confirm in the live browser that the application loads from http://localhost:3000 without a fatal browser error and that text typed into the code editor appears in it. External font, script or CDN asset requests are allowed. If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension.' This is all-or-nothing zeroing, not partial credit, and is stricter than the template's wording (template scored prompts lines 9-13 / 8-12 / 16-20), which for an app without sign-in reduces to load-only. Same-origin: no prompt or criterion requires it; all five prompts state CDN/external assets are allowed, app_context.md:31 repeats it, and the only 'origin' wording is 'clear this origin's browser storage' (storage scope) and in-page replay of a recorded request, neither of which constrains where the app loads assets from. The Internal sheet's 'cross-origin apps' wording for check 29 conflicts with the public Quality sheet ('must NOT require same-origin') and the skill's delivery profile; the task follows the latter, which is correct. Counterexamples tried: (a) static shell with a non-editable picture of an editor fails the typed-word leg in render and in every scored prompt; (b) client-only app saving to localStorage/IndexedDB fails cw_shared_saved_record after storage clearing; (c) app loading fonts/scripts from a CDN is not failed by any gate; (d) conforming canvas-drawn editor is still passable because app_context.md:28 tells the judge to read text from screenshots; (e) an app whose Run is broken is not zeroed by the gate (render judge.toml:23 'Do not press Run'; app_context.md:29), so the gate carries no unrelated difficulty. Runtime: scripted golden on these exact bytes reports cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing true (results/runtime.json) and cw_shared_saved_record true (results/persist-before.json); the hosted run where both gates passed for Oracle and nop scored 0 was on an EARLIER candidate whose render gate differed, so no configured-judge run has exercised the current gate wording. That is unmeasured and is not claimed here; this row is decided from the frozen source. Two minor non-blocking observations: (1) tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:7 says '0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all', which reads against line 5's 'assign 0 to every criterion' for an app whose editor is drawn but cannot be typed into; the real render gate zeroes that app first, so impact is latent (P3). (2) The in-dimension gate does not restate the server-backing leg; the template's in-dimension gate has none either and the constraints gate carries it, so this is not a defect.
suggested_fix: Optional, P3: in tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:7 change to '0 is used only when the thing being judged is not shown at all, or when the global browser gate above fails' so the two sentences cannot be read against each other.
